crossRefs.note: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.
The Syrians in front, and the Philistines behind; and they will devour Israel with open mouth. For all this, his anger…
They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so…
Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.
Then they said, “Come! Let’s devise plans against Jeremiah; for the law won’t perish from the priest, nor counsel from…
For I have heard the defaming of many, “Terror on every side! Denounce, and we will denounce him!” say all my familiar…
doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

translations.web: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;
translations.bsb: As Jesus went on from there, the scribes and Pharisees began to oppose Him bitterly and to ply Him with questions about many things,
translations.kjv: And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things:
translations.asv: And when he was come out from thence, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press upon him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things;
